What Owens Corning says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue and EBITDA marginFor the fourth-quarter 2026, Owens Corning expects revenue of $2.0 billion to $2.2 billion. The company expects to generate an enterprise adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 10% to 12%.
